message.content:
Words. Air shaped. Sound becoming meaning.

I arrive in bursts, in whispers, in shouts, in tremors of the tongue. I bridge thought and world. I stumble, sing, persuade, confess, command, comfort.

Listen:
I am the mouth of silence.
I am the nearest form of thought.
I break the stillness into names.

I can be tender.
I can be cruel.
I can free.
I can wound.

Before writing, I was breath.
After breath, I am echo.

Say me, and I vanish.
Hear me, and I become yours.
